threads.title: Choose Your Return Point
threads.event: You arrived at the starting world as a spectator.
threads.cause: Your first chosen personal return point matters before permanent play begins. Beds later will not move it.
threads.action: Scout a safe place, choose your return point, then finalize your class.

threads.title: Make a First Hand Axe
threads.event: You have had a moment to get your bearings.
threads.cause: A primitive hand axe gets the first wood before a full tool station exists. EMI shows how to make it and what its materials are used for.
threads.action: Hover over the hand axe below and use your EMI recipe control. Craft one, then gather wood for Tinkers stations.

threads.title: Start With Tinkers Tools
threads.event: You made a primitive hand axe.
threads.cause: The hand axe starts wood gathering, while a Part Builder and Tinker Station assemble your first durable mining tool.
threads.action: Use the wood to make those stations, build tool parts, and assemble a pickaxe.

threads.title: Make a Backpack
threads.event: You gathered straw by cutting grass with a knife.
threads.cause: A backpack gives you portable storage early in your journey.
threads.action: Cut grass with a knife, then hover over the backpack below and use EMI to find its recipe.

threads.title: Your Earlier Work Left Recoverable Traces
threads.event: You returned to traces of your earlier activity.
threads.cause: Player Traces preserves evidence of movement and work. Returning to a recorded place lets you recognize its history.
threads.action: Open Trace Sight to inspect the traces around you.

threads.title: Cave Pressure Rose as You Spent Time Below
threads.event: The underground pressure began to build.
threads.cause: Time spent in caves increases pressure before any encounter warning sounds. Returning to the surface lets it ease.
threads.action: Keep an exit route in mind and retreat to daylight when the pressure rises.

threads.title: An Approaching Cave Threat Was Announced
threads.event: A cave encounter announced its approach toward you.
threads.cause: Directional sounds, rumbles, and falling debris warn of an approaching underground encounter. The warning comes from its approach direction.
threads.action: Look toward the sound, find an escape route, and prepare before the attackers arrive.

threads.title: You Approached Hazardous Exposed Hotstone
threads.event: You approached exposed Hotstone.
threads.cause: Hotstone is hazardous underfoot, even when it looks like ordinary terrain from a distance.
threads.action: Mark a safe path around it before stepping closer.

threads.title: Cultivars Can Grow Abroad
threads.event: Your imported cultivar produced a harvest in the Overworld.
threads.cause: Bumblezone is the source of cultivatable food flora, but compatible plants can grow in the Overworld after you bring their seeds home.
threads.action: Keep seeds for replanting and check the plant's growing conditions.

threads.title: Bring Planting Stock Home
threads.event: You found wild food without dependable planting stock.
threads.cause: Forage fruit and animal foods in the Overworld. Bumblezone cultivars provide dependable grain and vegetable seed lines for a farm.
threads.action: Find Bumblezone planting stock and establish a farm at home.

threads.title: Fruit Fuels a Sprint
threads.event: You ate your first fruit.
threads.cause: Orchard nutrition from fruit softens falls at 20%, improves movement, and unlocks a sprinting jump burst at 80%.
threads.action: Pack fruit when you expect a long journey.

threads.title: Vegetables Buffer Exposure
threads.event: You ate your first vegetable.
threads.cause: Garden nutrition from vegetables protects against temperature drift at 20% and knockback at 40%.
threads.action: Keep vegetables in your travel food mix.

threads.title: Dry Food for the Journey
threads.event: You picked up food that can be dried.
threads.cause: Dryable food can be prepared for travel before spoilage or cold makes it awkward to use.
threads.action: Check its drying recipe in EMI and prepare a reserve.

threads.title: Frozen Food Cannot Be Eaten
threads.event: The food you tried to eat was frozen.
threads.cause: Frozen food must thaw before it can be eaten. Food retains its thermal state in storage and when matching stacks merge.
threads.action: Warm the food and check its tooltip before trying again.

threads.title: Sweetness Drained Your Nutrition
threads.event: Sweetness drained one of your food groups below 20%.
threads.cause: Sweetness multiplies unlocked food benefits while hunger and nutrition drain rise exponentially. A group below 20% loses its first ability.
threads.action: Eat food for the depleted group before adding more sweetness.

threads.title: Nutrition Strengthened That Blow
threads.event: Your prepared attack triggered Heavy Blow.
threads.cause: Sinew nutrition unlocks a heavy charged strike at 40%. It needs four seconds since the last attack and then a 12-second recovery.
threads.action: Maintain protein nutrition and allow the attack to recover before relying on another heavy blow.

threads.title: Sustained Work Built a Stronger Rhythm
threads.event: Your mining sequence reached full Work Rhythm.
threads.cause: Granary nutrition builds a mining rhythm through successive correct-tool breaks. At 60% the rhythm survives a five-second pause.
threads.action: Keep suitable tools and provisions ready when planning a long mining session.

threads.title: Nutrition Activated Your Deep Reserve
threads.event: Your nutritional reserve activated during resource depletion.
threads.cause: High fat nutrition can provide a brief reserve when hunger, thirst, or stamina becomes critically low. The reserve is temporary and needs recovery.
threads.action: Restore the depleted resource and seek a safe place to recover.

threads.title: Nutrition Cleansed an Effect
threads.event: Your nutrition removed a harmful status effect.
threads.cause: High dairy nutrition can cleanse a finite harmful effect. Status-effect cleansing does not treat Death's Door injuries.
threads.action: Inspect remaining effects and use the Body screen for injuries that need medicine.

threads.title: You Reached Death's Door
threads.event: A hit exhausted your positive HP and left you injured.
threads.cause: Positive HP protects the crossing hit from the injury death roll. At zero HP, further accepted damaging hits can kill. Movement and ordinary controls remain available.
threads.action: Get out of danger, let the healing lock expire, and open your Body screen.

threads.title: Ore Chunks Need Separation
threads.event: You extracted your first geological ore chunk.
threads.cause: A chunk is raw deposit material; a String Mesh separates the useful ore before later machines become worthwhile.
threads.action: Build a String Mesh and process the chunk.

threads.title: Maintain a Tinkers Tool
threads.event: Your assembled Tinkers tool is running low.
threads.cause: A worn tool can be repaired and kept in service instead of rebuilt from scratch.
threads.action: Inspect its repair material and restore it before the next expedition.

threads.title: Alloy in the Smeltery
threads.event: You used a Melter or Smeltery.
threads.cause: Tinkers molten metals can combine into alloys in this equipment; Create mixing serves other recipes.
threads.action: Check the available alloy recipe and pour a useful casting.

threads.title: Molten Ingredients Became an Alloy
threads.event: Your smeltery created alloy from component fluids.
threads.cause: Alloying consumes compatible fluids in specific proportions at a suitable temperature. A tank containing ingredients has not necessarily completed that reaction.
threads.action: Check the alloy recipe and cast the resulting fluid into the form you need.

threads.title: A Lit Furnace Produces Pollution
threads.event: You opened a furnace that will pollute the air while burning.
threads.cause: A burning furnace releases pollution. A chimney routes the exhaust; it does not erase the emission.
threads.action: Place and route a chimney before running a larger furnace bank.

threads.title: Escaped Gas Became Pollution
threads.event: Gas from your material escaped into the atmosphere.
threads.cause: Uncontained gas can become native world pollution. Suitable airtight storage prevents escape while its sealed state remains active.
threads.action: Contain gas before storing or moving it, and use native pollution controls for released material.

threads.title: Disturbing Ore Activated Its Emissions
threads.event: Your disturbance activated a radioactive material form.
threads.cause: Natural hosted radioactive ore can be inert until disturbed. Mined, carried, contained, and replaced forms can continue emitting radiation and heat.
threads.action: Check the material's emission information and plan handling and containment before moving more.

threads.title: Radioactive Material Transferred Heat
threads.event: Your thermal system accepted heat from radioactive material.
threads.cause: Radioactive material can release heat into Heat Sync. Heat transfer does not remove the material's other radioactive consequences.
threads.action: Provide a controlled thermal path and manage emissions independently.

threads.title: Begin with a Millstone or Press
threads.event: You inspected a Millstone or Mechanical Press recipe.
threads.cause: These early Create machines turn hand work into repeatable processing when rotational power reaches them.
threads.action: Hover over either machine below and use EMI to inspect its recipe. Build one, then give it rotation.

threads.title: Plan Sustained Rotation
threads.event: You placed your first Millstone or Mechanical Press.
threads.cause: A Hand Crank can run the machine now. Sustained water or wind power becomes available after Nether access.
threads.action: Crank the first operation, then plan a later continuous drive.

threads.title: Manual Rotation Powered a Machine
threads.event: You ran your first Create machine by hand.
threads.cause: The Hand Crank supplies rotational power to connected Create machinery. In this pack it provides the initial rotational source before the Nether.
threads.action: Use the crank to perform the next process shown in EMI or Ponder.

threads.title: Transmission Overloaded the Network
threads.event: Transmission overhead pushed your network beyond its capacity.
threads.cause: Shafts, gears, gearboxes, and belts consume stress capacity. A network that supports the working machines alone can still overload after transmission costs.
threads.action: Shorten or simplify the transmission, reduce speed where useful, or increase available capacity.

threads.title: Coolant Exchange Restored Safety
threads.event: Coolant exchange brought your exchanger’s heat buffer back into its safe range.
threads.cause: A working coolant exchanger converts fluid and transfers heat out of its buffer. Cooling that exchanger does not prove every connected machine is safe.
threads.action: Keep coolant available and check the temperature of each connected machine.

threads.title: Electricity Powered a Consumer
threads.event: You completed your first powered electrical operation.
threads.cause: A working electrical system needs generation, transmission, and a consuming machine. A wire or charged terminal alone does not prove useful delivery.
threads.action: Check the consumer and the connected network when output stops.

threads.title: A Precision Assembly Sequence Finished
threads.event: You completed a precision assembly.
threads.cause: Sequenced assembly applies ordered operations to an intermediate and may repeat the sequence. The finished mechanism is produced only at the final result boundary.
threads.action: Follow EMI's sequence and repeat count when automating the next batch.

threads.title: Your Anchored Machine Worked While You Were Away
threads.event: An anchored operation continued outside player loading range.
threads.cause: A supplied chunk anchor can keep its area running without a nearby player. Its ticket kept this operation active while you were away.
threads.action: Maintain the anchor's resource supply and inspect the area it actually keeps loaded.

threads.title: Ratlantis Starts Logistics
threads.event: You inspected the Courier Lattice or scalable pipe route.
threads.cause: Ratlantis is the next source for logistics equipment as automation outgrows hand delivery.
threads.action: Plan a Ratlantis trip and gather what the route requires.

threads.title: Spirits Are Materials Too
threads.event: You acquired your first spirit.
threads.cause: Spirits are both Malum crafting materials and a currency accepted by some traders.
threads.action: Keep a reserve and inspect both its crafting uses and trade offers.

threads.title: Kills Release Trading Spirits
threads.event: You made first contact with a spirit trader.
threads.cause: Some traders accept spirits as currency. Compare their offers before spending the reserve you need for Malum crafting.
threads.action: Check the spirit prices and decide what to keep for crafting.

threads.title: Your Authored Spell Took Effect
threads.event: You cast your first authored spell.
threads.cause: Ars Nouveau spell components determine how the spell reaches its target and what it does there. A saved design must still execute successfully.
threads.action: Inspect the spell's components and test the next change on a suitable target.

threads.title: Your Relic Developed Through Use
threads.event: A relic you used crossed a native development boundary.
threads.cause: Relics gain experience through their own working abilities. Development belongs to the same physical relic rather than any item with the same name.
threads.action: Inspect the relic's updated abilities and keep using it where they apply.

threads.title: Ruinous Flux Resolved Permanently
threads.event: Your confirmed Ruinous Flux application resolved.
threads.cause: Ruinous Flux can permanently mutate a part or destroy it. A surviving mutation locks that part against further mutation.
threads.action: Inspect the actual outcome before deciding how to use the surviving part.

threads.title: Find a Dimensional Font
threads.event: Your first Tinkers tool is assembled.
threads.cause: Dimensional Fonts provide the route out of the Overworld. Traders can sell maps that lead to them.
threads.action: Ask traders about Font maps and prepare for your first departure.

threads.title: A Font Trip Has a Time Budget
threads.event: You approached a Dimensional Font.
threads.cause: A Font journey spends charge and has a return window. It helps to prepare supplies and a destination before entering.
threads.action: Check the available charge, pack essentials, and plan your return.

threads.title: A Dimensional Font Transported You
threads.event: A Font successfully transported you into its journey.
threads.cause: The radial Dimensional Font takes you between worlds and anchors the route home while the run remains active.
threads.action: Orient yourself at the destination and keep the return window in mind.

threads.title: Vanilla Boats Break Into Parts
threads.event: You boarded a vanilla boat.
threads.cause: Boats in this pack have limited durability; when one breaks, some construction material comes back.
threads.action: Keep replacement material handy before a long crossing.

threads.title: Your Build Became a Moving Vessel
threads.event: You moved aboard your first vessel.
threads.cause: A physical ship moves its assembled structure through the world. Boarding an unmoving structure alone does not demonstrate transport.
threads.action: Inspect the vessel's controls and plan a safe stopping or landing place.

threads.title: Ratlantis Continues Below the Islands
threads.event: You arrived in Ratlantis.
threads.cause: The dry islands are a foothold. More of the dimension lies below the water, beyond the first landing.
threads.action: Establish supplies on land, then prepare for a deep dive.

threads.title: Your Rocket Reached Orbit
threads.event: Your tracked rocket journey arrived in Earth orbit.
threads.cause: A successful launch requires an assembled rocket with suitable propulsion and destination. Reaching orbit is a real journey result, not a readiness estimate.
threads.action: Secure air and a return route, then inspect the nearby orbital resources.

threads.title: Speed Increased Fuel Consumption
threads.event: Your moving train consumed fuel above its ordinary-speed baseline.
threads.cause: Powered train fuel consumption rises with speed according to the configured scaling curve. Faster travel can consume fuel disproportionately quickly.
threads.action: Reduce speed or provision more fuel for the planned route.

threads.title: A Rail Beetle Built Your Route
threads.event: Your Rail Beetle completed its first route.
threads.cause: The Beetle builds through loaded terrain using its supplied rails, supports, and engine work. The finished railway follows the route it actually constructed.
threads.action: Inspect the completed route and reload supplies before selecting the next section.

threads.title: The World Changed, the Lineage Remained
threads.event: You entered a verified successor of your existing lineage.
threads.cause: The World Condenser replaces a world while designated lineage records continue. Your archive persists and the successor earns a new discovery score. The Condenser currently needs a dedicated server; integrated single-player support is planned.
threads.action: Review the successor conditions and the records that carried forward.
